page.title: Alert e-mail
page.description: The relay, the message and the recipients of alert e-mail. Times are UTC.
page.leaveConfirm: A template has unsaved changes. Leave this page and lose them?

forbidden.heading: Alert e-mail cannot be shown to this account.
forbidden.body: Reading and changing it needs the <perm>admin:notifications</perm> permission. The read-only role does not include it. Nothing was changed.

error.advice: Nothing was changed. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again.

relay.heading: Relay

notConfigured.heading: No alert e-mail can leave this site.
notConfigured.body: SMTP_HOST is empty. Set SMTP_HOST and SMTP_PORT in .env on the server, with SMTP_SECURITY, SMTP_USERNAME, SMTP_PASSWORD and SMTP_FROM as the relay needs them, then restart the backend and the worker and reload this page. Read the guide.

insecure.heading: No alert e-mail is sent with this configuration.

status.note: Configured means the host is set. The test send checks that the relay answers.

relay.envNote: The connection and the password are set in .env on the server and cannot be changed here. The password is never shown. How the relay is set.

templates.heading: Templates
templates.intro: The default template is sent for every alert type that has no template of its own. Choose one to edit it.

editor.heading: {label} template

state.defaultOwn: This is the stored default template. Every alert type without a template of its own sends it.
state.defaultOff: A default template is stored but switched off, so alert e-mail sends the shipped template. The fields show the stored text.
state.defaultNone: No default template is stored, so alert e-mail sends the shipped template. The fields show it; saving stores your version as the default.
state.typeOwn: This is the stored template for {label} alerts.
state.typeOff: A template for {label} alerts is stored but switched off, so these alerts send {fallback}. The fields show the stored text.
state.typeFallback: {label} alerts have no template of their own, so they send {fallback}. The fields show it; saving stores your version for this type only.

editor.subject: Subject
editor.htmlHint: Saving keeps only the HTML that is safe in an e-mail. Other tags, attributes and styles are removed, and the editor then shows what was kept.
editor.textHint: Leave empty to derive the plain-text part from the HTML body.
editor.enabledHint: When off, the template stays stored and alert e-mail sends {fallback} instead.
editor.sanitiserChanged: The sanitiser changed the HTML you typed. The editor now shows what is stored and what will be sent.
editor.sanitiserKept: The sanitiser kept the HTML as typed.
editor.resetDefaultBody: The stored default template is deleted and alert e-mail goes back to the template shipped with the product. Types with a template of their own keep it.

resetTypeBody.default: The stored {label} template is deleted. These alerts then send the default template. The default is not changed.
resetTypeBody.shipped: The stored {label} template is deleted. These alerts then send the shipped template, because no default template is in use.

editor.resetLosesDraft: Your unsaved changes to it are lost as well.

placeholders.heading: Placeholders
placeholders.unavailable: The placeholder list could not be read, so none can be inserted. Reload the page to try again.
placeholders.help: Choose a placeholder to insert it at the cursor, in the field you used last. Write it as {syntax}. In the HTML part its value is HTML-escaped; in the text part it is plain; a missing value shows as a dash.

preview.heading: Preview
preview.sampleNote: The preview fills the placeholders with a fixed sample alert of the chosen type. It is never a real alert.
preview.failed: The preview could not be built.
preview.failedAdvice: Correct the template and update the preview. Nothing was saved.
preview.outOfDateNote: The editor has changed since this preview was built.
preview.subject: Subject

test.heading: Send a test message
test.note: Sends the message above, as the editor holds it now whether saved or not, to one mailbox through the relay. The subject starts with [Test]. Limited to {limit}.
test.noteNoLimit: Sends the message above, as the editor holds it now whether saved or not, to one mailbox through the relay. The subject starts with [Test].
test.notConfigured: No relay is configured, so nothing can be sent. Set SMTP_HOST in .env first.
test.settingsUnread: The relay settings could not be read, so the test send stays off until they can be.
test.acceptedHeading: The relay accepted the test message.
test.failedHeading: The test message was not sent.
test.retryLater: Wait a minute, then send again.
test.notSent: The test message was not sent.
test.unknownOutcome: The relay reported an outcome this page does not word.

next.sent: Check the mailbox, including its junk folder. A relay accepting a message does not prove it was delivered.
next.not_configured: After setting it, restart the backend and the worker and reload this page.
next.insecure_login: Restart the backend and the worker after the change, then send again.
next.connection_refused: Run ./qradar-dash doctor --check-smtp on the server to test the connection without sending anything.
next.timeout: Run ./qradar-dash doctor --check-smtp on the server to test the connection without sending anything.
next.connection_failed: Run ./qradar-dash doctor --check-smtp on the server to test the connection without sending anything.
next.tls_failed: Run ./qradar-dash doctor --check-smtp on the server to see the handshake without sending anything.
next.auth_failed: Correct the credentials in .env, restart the backend and the worker, then send again. The password is never shown here.
next.recipient_refused: Try another mailbox. If every mailbox is refused, ask the relay's administrator which domains it accepts.
next.sender_refused: Ask the relay's administrator which sender addresses it accepts, correct SMTP_FROM in .env, then restart the backend and the worker.
next.server_error: Read the relay's own log: this page never shows the relay's reply text. Then send again.

recipients.heading: Recipients
recipients.noneStored: No recipient is stored in the application.

nobody.heading: No alert e-mail is sent.
nobody.noneStored: No recipient is stored here and NOTIFY_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS in .env is empty. Add a recipient to start sending.
nobody.allOff: Every stored recipient is switched off and NOTIFY_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS in .env is empty. Switch a recipient on to start sending.

recipients.removeBody: This address stops receiving alert e-mail at once. Nothing else changes.

env.heading: From .env
env.note: These addresses come from NOTIFY_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS in .env. They receive every alert, LOW and above, and cannot be changed here.

form.severityHint: The recipient gets alerts at this severity and above.
form.typesNone: Choose at least one alert type.
form.typesUnavailable: The alert types could not be read, so a recipient can only be added for every type. Reload the page to try again.
form.enabled: Send alert e-mail to this address
